name: reconnect__subscribe_after_session_evict
description: Recovery-from-reconnect contract: when a CASE session is evicted (peer reconnect, CASE-resume failure, RemoveFabric, ...), the bridge MUST cleanly accept a fresh SubscribeRequest on the new session without leaking state from the old one. Two sessions are wired in the harness. Session A is pre-registered with a subscription; the scenario closes session A (cascading subscription eviction), then drives a peer-side SubscribeRequest on session B. Drain consumes the initial ReportData chunks and asserts the SubscribeResponse arrives on session B's exchange. Catches regressions where stale subTarget entries from session A bleed into session B's negotiation or where the bridge mis-routes the SubscribeResponse.
